  "ease_of_use_rating": 4,

  "overall_rating": 4,
  "value_for_money_rating": 5,
  "customer_support_rating": 4,
  "recommendation_score": 8,
  "pros": [
    "Securely manages shared passwords for client projects across the team.",
    "Granular user access controls and permissions simplify onboarding and offboarding.",
    "Affordable solution with robust features for a small business."
  ],
  "cons": [
    "Initial setup and organization of shared vaults took some time.",
    "Occasional issues with the browser extension not syncing or requiring re-login.",
    "Learning curve for some advanced team management features."
  ],
  "overall_experience": "This administrative assistant found Bitwarden to be a highly valuable and secure solution for managing client project passwords within their small business. The ability to control user access and share credentials securely with multiple employees was a significant improvement. While the initial setup required some effort and there were minor frustrations with the browser extension, the overall benefits of improved security and efficiency outweighed these drawbacks."
}
